_notes.schema: Per KPI: key (stable id), label/label_en, aliases (old labels still accepted by the baselines route), parquet, unit/unit_en/unit_kind (count|percent_rate|per_mille_rate|currency), source_code/source_title(_en), definition(_en), measure additive|non_additive, partitions = columns collapsed (declared complete disjoint partitions, FIX-02 declared_partitions), weights = aligned weight parquet for non-additive measures, allow_approximation = permit a named unweighted mean when no weights exist, suppress = reason the KPI is not shown.
_notes.unemployment: Our SOM103A export has only Masculin/Feminin rows (INS publishes Total; the fetch dropped it). The registered_unemployment_county recipe serves INS's published Total cells (published_totals) when the generation has them, else reconstructs the rate from SOM101E year-end counts (method_note).
_notes.wage: Our FOM106E export has no all-activities total row (INS publishes it; the fetch dropped it). The net_earnings_county recipe serves INS's published Total cells when the generation has them, else weights CAEN sections × sex by FOM104F employees (method_note).
_notes.rates: Birth/death rates are published for Urban/Rural only; they are combined with POP105A resident-population weights per residence area and year (so periods before POP105A starts in 2012 are not shown).

The sums match INS's Total in every spot check, but the series rule (same coverage in every period) withholds it.

featured_localities._note: Large-city list shown on /places. A municipality is listed when its resident population is at least `threshold` in `population_year`. TEMPO has no resident population at UAT level, so the basis is the RPL 2021 census (core-assets data/geo/uat-populatie.csv, INS Table 1.03.2), the latest resident count per UAT. `siruta` keys the rows of the locality parquets (REF_AREA_2 is '<SIRUTA> NAME'). KPI cards exist only for the items of type locality; Bucharest is a county-level place and is linked, not duplicated.
